quests.title: Any Unsolved Mysteries?

dialogue.t: This place sure looks pretty normal.
Guess there won't be anything to eat here...

dialogue.sit: Don't give yourself away too soon, Paimon.

dialogue.t: *cough* W—Well, y'know, looking for secrets is hungry work! Everyone knows that!
And anyway, we've recently been eating barbecue a lot to save time. Aren't you sick of that already?
If we can find some shells or conches, we can stew them with some fruit.
They'll be fresh and sweet and springy...

dialogue.sit: That sounds pretty terrible. Not my cup of tea.
Sounds like how you'd taste, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Come on, give it go! It might open a whole new culinary world to you!
Wait a moment! Look over there, {NICKNAME}.
That's weird, that device just appeared all of a sudden.
And there's some luggage nearby, too. Is that Fatui gear?

dialogue.sit: Huh. Right on the Mora, Paimon. Good work.

dialogue.t: Right? Paimon was right on the Mora...
Waaait a moment. There's nothing good about this discovery!
If this is Fatui business, then there's gotta be some scheme afoot!
If we leave this thing be, things might eventually get out of control.
Whatever the case, let's see what we can do about that device first. If you think we should, let's have a look through that Fatui gear.
Let's do this like we always do, {NICKNAME}, and then we can kick back and start looking for something to eat instead!

quests.description: Paimon suddenly has a mysterious feeling and suggests that you take another trip to the Golden Apple Archipelago to have a close look around…
